description: Latvijas iedzīvotāju ceļojumi is a dataset listed in data.gov.lv, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Centrālā statistikas pārvalde. Latvian residents' overnight trips and used accommodation during trips abroad and across Latvia. Descriptive metadata. Structural metadata. Coverage: Centrālā statistikas pārvalde. The portal shows the English title as "Travel by residents of Latvia" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Centrālā statistikas pārvalde. Its keywords include tul050, naktsmītnes, tul100, tul060, braucieni, tul080. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2019-09-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-lv.
